selection_rule: First two completed best-of-three or best-of-five series in displayed newest-first results order, with official demos, excluding all previously used match IDs. Freeze exact selection before downloading; no replacement based on scores or pipeline results. If unavailable, record failure and stop rather than silently substitute.
scope: Small new-series validation, not a large OOD benchmark; both map and series boundaries retained.
amendment_reason: The original September 1-6 window contained only previously used series. Widen the lookback before browsing the new window; keep all other selection rules. New means unseen by this repository, not necessarily later in calendar time.
